intent_dna_assessment: The implementation preserves availability while keeping invalid input fail-closed, evidenced, and outside the normal inbox.
finding: The first approval-source implementation fetched current content separately from its latest modifying commit, permitting a TOCTOU mismatch. Live runner use also proved that accepting only 64-character object IDs rejects GitHub's current 40-character SHA-1 commits.
remediation: Resolve the approval commit first, then fetch receipt content at that exact ref; accept only exact 40- or 64-character lowercase Git object IDs; add regression tests for ref binding and malformed object IDs.
remaining_risks: Windows Scheduled Task and GitHub CLI integration still require execution on the owner's PC.
Quarantine growth requires normal mailbox retention monitoring.
Verification completion does not authorize merge or deployment.
rollback: Revert the feature commit; retain quarantine bytes and BLOCKED receipts for diagnosis.
